versions.content: Defining the dimension of an ApplicationPrimitive- DataType of category VAL_BLK An ApplicationPrimitiveDataType of cat- egory VAL_BLK that has only one dimension shall be described using the attribute SwDataDefProps . swValueBlockSize . An ApplicationPrimitiveDataType of category VAL_BLK that has more than one dimension shall be described using the attribute SwDataDefProps . swValue- BlockSizeMult .
